children: Niki BioSolutions disclosed its corporate presentation highlighting the Aptorum–DiamiR all-stock merger completion, validated assays, and near-term pharma services revenue.
All-stock merger closed July 20, 2026: DiamiR ~70% / Aptorum ~30% of combined company, creating diagnostic + therapeutics synergies.
Operating CLIA/CAP/NY State‑licensed lab in New Haven, CT with proprietary microRNA platform and validated protein assays.
CogniMIR® analytically validated; clinical validation anticipated in 2027 and >2,000 samples collected for validation.
APOE genotyping NY State‑approved and in routine operation; first pharma customer signed, revenue-generating from 3Q 2026.
Dual growth strategy: near-term pharma services (assay development, biomarker testing) and mid-term clinical services for Alzheimer’s diagnostics.
